subject: Feasibility of the originally requested fixed payout table under the confirmed FREE overlap and later-HIT ODDS rules.
calibrationReference: optimal placement after the first five; the separate random result means uniform legal-center selection

enumeration.method: Integer finite differences of expansion-level expectations, accumulated over singleton/pair/triple intersections with the three trigger positions. This recovers every trigger triplet exactly from every possible first-five set.
enumeration.allArithmetic: signed 64-bit integers; no Monte Carlo and no floating-point payout or center-ranking comparisons

evidence.format: Canonical UTF-8 JSON Lines, one row per FREE triplet in lexicographic order; LF endings.
evidence.parallelization: The run used independent batches of FREE triplets on stdin. Concatenating their outputs in the same lexicographic triplet order gives the identical --all output.

necessaryPayoutChangeForOptimalReference.statement: At least one payout tier must be reduced by at least this fraction to make 50% possible under the optimal-play reference. This is a necessary lower bound; it does not mean reducing one arbitrary tier by this amount is sufficient.
necessaryPayoutChangeForOptimalReference.proof: If every nonzero payout is at least r times the original payout, every fixed placement policy pays at least r times its original expected amount. Maximizing over legal placement policies preserves that inequality. Every draw-independent mixture of layouts therefore has optimal-play RTP at least r times the globally minimal original RTP. To reach 50%, r must be at most 50 divided by that minimum.

scope: The originally requested payout table remains unchanged throughout this feasibility search.
The board has 25 distinct numbered cells and three permanently marked FREE cells.
A draw-independent layout may choose any three FREE sites and any three distinct trigger-number positions among the other 25 sites.
For level 2 the center has six on-board neighbors; level 3 uses the documented nearest-16 tie rule.
The center may be an existing FREE but may not be a first-five number HIT.
Extra ODDS is awarded once per covered initial FREE and once per final-three hit on the expansion footprint. First-five HIT overlaps earn no ODDS.
An arbitrary manual player can choose less profitable centers; the optimal-play result is the stated calibration reference, not a guaranteed realized return.
Credit rounding, Sugar awards and other external rewards are outside this base-game calculation.
